notes.title: Multi Player Beta Is Here!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce multi player beta for Crystalline Bliss!  Dive into the action with your friends in various ways:


Join Quick Match: Jump into games instantly.
Host Public Games: Open your lobby to players from around the world.
Invite to Private Games: Enjoy matches with just your friends.

Additionally, we're introducing the ability to host your own matchmaking server for a personalized multiplayer experience. For more details on setting this up, check our GitHub page or join the conversation on our Discord server.


What else is new?


Ghost Sets: Preview where crystals will fall, strategizing your next move.
Drop Sets Faster: Use the space bar (keyboard) or the Y button (controller) for quicker action.
Enhanced AI: Single-player games are now more challenging and engaging, thanks to improvements in computer player AI.
Balanced Difficulties: We've fine-tuned the game's difficulties, making certain effects less frequent to ensure a fairer and more enjoyable experience.


Dive into these updates and discover a more exciting and user-friendly gaming experience. We can't wait to see you and your friends in the game!
